triggerReason: The v4.8.5 production browser audit found that switching the visible interface to Chinese left the root document language declared as English, causing assistive technology to use the wrong pronunciation rules.
action: Synchronize the root html lang attribute with the persisted interface language in the client shell and require zh-CN both immediately after switching and after a reload.
outcome: Local acceptance passes 264 non-PostgreSQL tests, 16 real PostgreSQL/backup/restore tests, all deterministic v1/v2/v4 gates, 28/28 production-build Playwright/axe scenarios, 10,000 ticks, zero lint warnings, zero dependency vulnerabilities and the TypeScript production build. The pinned networkless Node 24.15.0 evaluator independently repeats lint, 264 tests, model regression and build from a frozen read-only source archive with dropped capabilities. Remote and production evidence are recorded only after their corresponding gates run.

metrics.label: Chinese UI with matching document language
